portable_candidate.name: Common-determinant extraction from lower-weight integral polynomial Frobenius rewrites
hypotheses: One common finite column set and integral coordinates.
Pointwise x1^p-Pp(x) in p*O on all columns.
Every correction monomial has weight below p*w1.
Nonzero determinant and an independently proved Archimedean height bound.
portable_candidate.conclusion_paper_level: Delta in p^(sum floor(alpha1/p))*O for every usable prime, simultaneously.
portable_candidate.formalization_status: Generalized statement derived at paper level, not compiled as a new Lean theorem.

transfer_gates.finding: Fixed beta<1 matched harmonic diagnostic source is -m*(1-M^(beta-1))/(1-beta), bounded rather than proportional to log M.
transfer_gates.campaign_single_mode_bound: Absolute value at most 8*m when beta<=7/8.
transfer_gates.scope: This harmonic source channel; not all determinant mechanisms.

transfer_gates.finding: At fixed nonzero y, p^(-iy) is a root of unity for at most one rational prime. It cannot replace a finite-order Frobenius character across prime columns.
transfer_gates.scope: Finite-order substitution only; arbitrary algebraic polynomial closure remains open.

transfer_gates.finding: Prime-dependent column deletion generally changes the determinant; separate divisibilities cannot be multiplied without proving they belong to the same nonzero integer.
Cubic/allowed angular SW families already avoid exceptional real characters; the Type-I input is unconditional. No native growing quadratic-twist or model-source gate was discharged.
A c/log D zero gap at D=X^kappa permits X^beta=X*exp(-c/kappa); that gap alone supplies no fixed power saving.
